risk_note: RV2 by path (orders). Two long-run fixes to the rescan, neither touching amounts or attribution. First, a fixed 30-minute tolerance in rescanStep: a cursor up to 30 minutes older than the sliding round start stays put, so a first window that runs past one tick is no longer rewound and its CAS hits; it is under the one-hour start margin, so adapters still accept it at days=90. Second, update-step reject() logs its P1 unless the rejection is a true repeat: writePending reads inserted (xmax = 0) and the stored raw_status and detail from the same statement, and only an existing open row with both equal stays quiet. Events, pending writes and return values are unchanged; a different unmapped code still alerts (BR-FUND-02).
